name: AI Strategy & Readiness
short: Find where AI can strengthen your work and turn the best opportunities into a practical plan.
headline: Make your next AI move with clarity and confidence.
problem: AI opportunities can be hard to separate from passing trends, especially when teams are already testing disconnected tools. Without a shared view of readiness, priorities and risk, promising ideas stall or create extra complexity. We help you make informed choices and set a direction your organisation can act on.
whoFor: Leaders seeking a grounded view of AI opportunities and risks
Teams whose AI experiments have not yet become repeatable practice
Organisations aligning stakeholders around a common AI direction
Businesses seeking experienced AI leadership for a defined initiative

offers.name: AI Readiness Scan
offers.summary: A focused assessment of your current capabilities and the most relevant next steps for AI.
includes: Review of strategy, data, processes, people and governance

offers.name: AI Opportunity Workshop
offers.summary: A facilitated session that turns business challenges into considered AI opportunities.
includes: Use-case assessment against value, feasibility and risk
Shortlist of candidate initiatives and next actions

offers.name: AI Transformation Roadmap
offers.summary: A sequenced roadmap that connects AI initiatives to business priorities and accountable owners.
includes: Phased roadmap with dependencies and owners

offers.name: AI Business Case & ROI Model
offers.summary: A transparent business case to help you evaluate an AI initiative before committing to delivery.
includes: Baseline and benefit measures to validate

offers.name: Fractional AI Officer
offers.summary: Ongoing senior guidance to govern priorities and move your AI agenda forward.
includes: Review of initiatives, milestones and blockers
Guidance on tools and delivery partners

faqs.q: Do we need mature data systems to begin?
faqs.a: No. We assess your current data practices and identify what needs attention, while also considering opportunities that do not depend on extensive data.

faqs.q: Will recommendations lock us into a particular provider?
faqs.a: No. Recommendations are based on your needs and existing environment, with trade-offs made clear.

faqs.q: Can you help us move from a roadmap into delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. We can scope a build or ongoing support engagement, or hand over a clear plan for your team to deliver.

name: Automation & AI Agents
short: Reduce repetitive work with dependable automations and carefully governed AI agents.
headline: Make everyday workflows work harder for your team.
problem: Repeated data entry, hand-offs and routine queries take attention away from valuable work. Automation can help, but poorly designed flows break down, while an agent without clear boundaries can create avoidable risk. We map the right workflows, build with appropriate checks and support reliable operation.
whoFor: Teams dealing with recurring manual hand-offs and updates
Operations leaders improving the flow of routine work
Organisations evaluating agents for bounded, well-defined tasks
Teams whose existing automations need better reliability or oversight

offers.name: Automation Opportunity Audit
offers.summary: Identify which workflows are suitable for automation and what a sensible first step looks like.

offers.name: Workflow Automation Sprint
offers.summary: Design and deploy a clearly scoped workflow with testing, safeguards and handover.
includes: Error handling and human review points

offers.name: AI Agent Prototype
offers.summary: Test a defined agent use case in a controlled prototype before deciding whether to deploy it.

offers.name: Custom AI Agent Build
offers.summary: Build a purpose-designed agent connected to approved tools, with permissions and oversight defined.
includes: Agent scope, permissions and operating rules
Integration with agreed systems and information sources

offers.name: Multi-agent Workflows
offers.summary: Coordinate specialised agents through a governed workflow for a complex, bounded process.

offers.name: Automation Care
offers.summary: Keep your workflows monitored, maintained and improved as your tools and processes change.

offers.name: Agent Hosting & Tuning
offers.summary: Maintain an agreed agent environment and refine its behaviour through structured reviews.
includes: Review of quality and exception patterns

faqs.q: What is the difference between automation and an AI agent?
faqs.a: An automation follows defined steps. An agent can choose between permitted actions to complete a task, so its scope and safeguards need careful design.

faqs.q: Which platforms can you work with?
faqs.a: We assess your existing systems and recommend an approach that fits your environment rather than requiring a particular platform.

faqs.q: Can an agent act without a person reviewing it?
faqs.a: The level of autonomy is agreed for each use case. We design approval or escalation points for actions that need human judgement.

short: Make customer conversations more helpful across calls, chat, WhatsApp and service journeys.
headline: Give every customer conversation a clearer next step.
problem: Customers expect useful answers and smooth hand-offs, yet teams often face repeated questions across disconnected channels. A conversational assistant helps when it is grounded in accurate information and knows when to involve a person. We design customer experiences around clarity, trust and practical service needs.
whoFor: Customer teams handling many recurring enquiries
Organisations improving how visitors find answers on their website
Service leaders exploring voice or messaging support
Businesses wanting a consistent way to gather and respond to feedback

offers.name: Customer Experience Review

offers.name: Website Chat Assistant

offers.name: AI Voice Front Desk (calls, booking, WhatsApp)

offers.name: Customer Support Automation

offers.name: Review & Reputation Monitoring

offers.name: Managed Assistant

faqs.q: Will the assistant replace our customer service team?
faqs.a: It handles agreed routine interactions and supports your team, with clear routes to a person when a question needs judgement.

faqs.q: How do you keep answers accurate?
faqs.a: We use approved information sources, test representative questions and define what the assistant does when it cannot answer confidently.

faqs.q: Can it connect to our booking or support tools?
faqs.a: We assess your systems during scoping and confirm what is practical for the chosen use case.
